description: Use case: the climate benefit of one kWh of photovoltaic electricity in Switzerland compared with two reference mixes. Without the displacement concept the benefit is the difference to the average Swiss consumption mix; with the FfE displacement concept the benefit is the difference to the marginal EU displacement mix, the fossil generation that an additional kWh pushes out of the European market. All figures are in gram CO2-eq per kWh over the life cycle: the Swiss mixes and the PV emission of 2018 are the KBOB/treeze figures per MJ converted to kWh, the EU displacement mix is the FfE key finding for the generation shares of 2015, and the two avoided emission values are derived by subtraction (see the note of each value).

sources.description: Kleinertz B., Pellinger C., von Roon S., Hübner T. (FfE Research Center for Energy Economics), Kaestle G.: EU Displacement Mix - A Simplified Marginal Method to Determine Environmental Factors for Technologies Coupling Heat and Power in the European Union. Final report for COGEN Europe, Munich, May 2018, ISBN 978-3-941802-39-1. Key finding (executive summary): the marginal CO2 equivalent emission factor of the EU-28 displacement mix incl. the upstream chain and 5 percent grid losses is 986 g CO2/kWh excluding nuclear power plants and 446 g CO2/kWh if nuclear power plants are included as must-run; generation shares from the Eurostat data of 2015.

# PV in Switzerland

| --- | ---: | ---: |
| avoided emission in CO2-eq gram per kWh | 79.2 | 939.2 |
 
The row is the avoided emission of one kWh of Swiss photovoltaic electricity. The
consumption mix column is the classic comparison with the average Swiss consumption
mix of 2018 (126 - 46.8), the displacement mix column the comparison with the marginal
EU-28 displacement mix of the FfE concept (986 - 46.8). The PV life cycle emission of
46.8 gram CO2-eq per kWh is the same in both columns; the two reference mixes are the
only difference, so the concept alone changes the benefit by a factor of about twelve.
With nuclear power plants as must-run the displacement mix drops to 446, which is
still five times the consumption mix.
